Messages.Author: lip
lip
Messages.Body:
For those interested and future contributors to the TWDA, I wanted to point out that you can use the KRCG api to get any decklist in legit precise TWDA format.

Just visit api.krcg.org and check the convert/{format} feature: click on "Try it out"

Select the "text/plain" format for your request body, then you can paste your decklist there (safer to omit headers, but the parser can handle a large number of formats, including Amaranth, VDB, Lackey, etc.)

Then hit execute and get your result ready to paste
